tasks.claim_text: Carbon dioxide absorbs infrared radiation and ocean acidity increases with carbon dioxide.
Sea level rise can result from both thermal expansion and melting land ice.
Atmospheric carbon dioxide was exactly 800 ppm in 2010.
The greenhouse effect depends on infrared radiation, not just incoming sunlight.

predeclared.primary_control: adaptive versus fixed_rerank; deterministic_extra is an additional stronger work control
predeclared.order: task order then fixed route order; no shuffle/seed/model selection
predeclared.sentence_mapping: Each existing evidence-only row is one intact passage at sentence index0; no new sentence segmentation or official sentence-gold claim
predeclared.preflight: Synthetic forced read A/B/A plus one-token truncation; separate model cost, no gold or task-quality score
predeclared.quality: Mechanical acceptance and model-selected tool execution only; semantic correctness remains unmeasured until independent review
predeclared.cost: Equal caps, not equal actual cost; include failed generations, unknown output flags and rerank pairs
predeclared.promotion: No automatic promotion to SciFact dev, old frozen tests, production or resume gain
